pages.text: $(italic)$(#6b5a45)Crafted at the Crafting Station. Low / Mid / High require colony level 1 / 10 / 20.$()$(br2)Carries a mage of your own colony in your pocket: shift+right-click a mage to store it, then right-click a block or the air to release it there. Low / Mid / High hold 1 / 2 / 4 mages.
